milestone: This cycle the command centre can answer the first question a stranger asks — what does this cost — honestly. Every published price is now read together rather than page by page, and the figures agree across every surface that quotes them. What the check refuses to call agreement is which company size belongs to which plan; that is being settled before anyone is quoted.
readiness: Built and tested, both suites green on the working tree this cycle. Publishing to the live site stays a deliberate manual step by the operator, never automatic. Pricing and the names of the plans are under review before they are published rather than after, so that a customer is quoted the same thing whichever page they arrive on.
